Different from case lifecycle

03 · Agent handoff

State model brief

Implement separate state machines for Case and Stage. CASE STATES Draft, Active, Waiting, Blocked, Ready for decision, Concluded, No-Go, Archived, Reopened. STAGE STATES Not started, In progress, Incomplete, Ready, Completed, Skipped, Blocked, Superseded. FOR EVERY TRANSITION DEFINE - source state - target state - user action or system trigger - required data - permissions - side effects - audit-log entry - notifications - editability changes - undo or reopen path RULES - No-Go is a valid terminal case state, not an error. - Skipped stages remain visible with a reason. - Concluded cases are readable and exportable. - Reopening appends history rather than erasing closure. - Blocked must always name the blocking condition. - Ready for decision means prerequisites are satisfied, not that the decision is positive.
